A whitespace-only inline element contributes exactly one space

```php title="PHP"
<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

require_once __DIR__ . '/vendor/autoload.php';

use HtmlToMarkdown\HtmlToMarkdown;
$result = HtmlToMarkdown::convert("<p>A<i> </i>B</p>");
var_dump($result->content);
```
